entries.name: Dwarf
entries.summary: As a Dwarf, you have these special traits.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries.text: You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

entries.name: Dwarven Toughness
entries.text: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

entries.name: Stonecunning
entries.text:
As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching a stone surface to use this Tremorsense. The stone can be natural or worked.

You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: Fighter
entries.summary: As a Fighter, you gain the following class features when you reach the specified Fighter levels.

attributes.dnd5e.armorProficiencies: Light, Medium, and Heavy armor and Shields
attributes.dnd5e.skillChoices: Choose 2: Acrobatics, Animal Handling, Athletics, History, Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion, Perception, or Survival

entries.name: Fighting Style
entries.text:
You have honed your martial prowess and gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice (see “Feats”). Defense is recommended.

Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace the feat you chose with a different Fighting Style feat.

entries.name: Second Wind
entries.text:
You have a limited well of physical and mental stamina that you can draw on. As a Bonus Action, you can use it to regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level.

You can use this feature twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

When you reach certain Fighter levels, you gain more uses of this feature, as shown in the Second Wind column of the Fighter Features table.
